summary: Completed comprehensive testing of crypto_buy and crypto_sell fiat transaction feature. All core functionality is working correctly - crypto_buy creates fiat debit + crypto Buy in destination wallet, crypto_sell creates fiat credit + crypto Sell in source wallet, and NO duplicate EUR Deposit/Withdrawal is created.

design_issues.issue: Missing Description or aria-describedby for accessibility

passed_tests: crypto_buy: Creates fiat transaction (type=crypto_buy) AND linked crypto Buy transaction in destination wallet
crypto_buy: Fiat transaction has linked_crypto_tx_id linking to crypto transaction
crypto_buy: Crypto transaction has type=Buy, source=fiat_purchase, positive amount
crypto_sell: Creates fiat transaction (type=crypto_sell) AND linked crypto Sell transaction in source wallet
crypto_sell: Fiat transaction has linked_crypto_tx_id linking to crypto transaction
crypto_sell: Crypto transaction has type=Sell, source=fiat_sale, negative amount
crypto_buy without dest_wallet_id only creates fiat transaction (no crypto tx)
Regular deposit transactions still work correctly
No duplicate EUR Deposit/Withdrawal created alongside crypto Buy/Sell
Frontend: 'Achat Crypto' type shows 'Crypto Reçue' section with wallet selector, asset dropdown, crypto amount
Frontend: 'Vente Crypto' type shows 'Crypto Vendue' section with wallet source selector, asset dropdown, crypto amount
Frontend: Regular 'Dépôt' type hides crypto fields correctly
seed_data_creation: Test created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed transactions during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Crypto buy/sell feature is fully functional. crypto_buy creates fiat debit + crypto Buy, crypto_sell creates fiat credit + crypto Sell. The fiat transactions have linked_crypto_tx_id field that links to the created crypto transaction. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_crypto_buy_sell.py contains comprehensive tests for this feature.
